faq.q: Can I crop to exact social media sizes?
faq.a: Use the preset ratios: 1:1 for Instagram posts, 9:16 for Stories/Reels, 16:9 for Twitter/X headers.

faq.q: Will the crop reduce image quality?
faq.a: No. Cropping simply removes pixels. The remaining area retains the original resolution and quality.

faq.q: How do I move the crop area?
faq.a: Drag anywhere inside the dashed overlay to move it. Drag the corner handles to resize.
